datasets.name: usr_kpi
queryLines: WITH h AS (SELECT dia, hora, count(DISTINCT usuario_id) AS n FROM quebec.gold.vw_usr_acessos WHERE dia BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY 1, 2), d AS (SELECT dia, count(DISTINCT usuario_id) AS n FROM quebec.gold.vw_usr_acessos WHERE dia BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY 1) SELECT count_if(NOT bloqueado) AS ativos, count_if(NOT bloqueado AND dias_sem_acesso <= 30) AS acessaram_30d, count_if(sem_acesso_30d) AS sem_acesso_30d, count_if(NOT bloqueado AND ultimo_acesso IS NULL) AS nunca_acessaram, count_if(bloqueado) AS bloqueados, (SELECT max(n) FROM h) AS pico_hora, (SELECT max(n) FROM d) AS pico_dia, (SELECT round(avg(n), 1) FROM d WHERE dayofweek(dia) BETWEEN 2 AND 6) AS media_dia_util, (SELECT count(DISTINCT usuario_id) FROM quebec.gold.vw_usr_acessos WHERE dia BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim) AS usuarios_no_periodo FROM quebec.gold.vw_usr_usuarios

datasets.name: usr_dia
queryLines: WITH h AS (SELECT dia, hora, count(DISTINCT usuario_id) AS n FROM quebec.gold.vw_usr_acessos WHERE dia BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT a.dia, count(DISTINCT a.usuario_id) AS usuarios, (SELECT max(n) FROM h WHERE h.dia = a.dia) AS pico_hora FROM quebec.gold.vw_usr_acessos a WHERE dia BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY a.dia ORDER BY a.dia

datasets.name: usr_mes
queryLines: WITH d AS (SELECT mes, dia, count(DISTINCT usuario_id) AS n FROM quebec.gold.vw_usr_acessos WHERE dia BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY 1, 2), h AS (SELECT mes, dia, hora, count(DISTINCT usuario_id) AS n FROM quebec.gold.vw_usr_acessos WHERE dia BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT m.mes, m.usuarios, d.media_dia_util, d.pico_dia, h.pico_hora FROM (SELECT mes, count(DISTINCT usuario_id) AS usuarios FROM quebec.gold.vw_usr_acessos WHERE dia BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY 1) m LEFT JOIN (SELECT mes, round(avg(CASE WHEN dayofweek(dia) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 THEN n END), 1) AS media_dia_util, max(n) AS pico_dia FROM d GROUP BY 1) d ON d.mes = m.mes LEFT JOIN (SELECT mes, max(n) AS pico_hora FROM h GROUP BY 1) h ON h.mes = m.mes ORDER BY m.mes

datasets.name: usr_hora
queryLines: WITH h AS (SELECT dia, hora, count(DISTINCT usuario_id) AS n FROM quebec.gold.vw_usr_acessos WHERE dia BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim AND dayofweek(dia) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT lpad(CAST(hora AS STRING), 2, '0') AS hora, round(avg(n), 1) AS media_usuarios, max(n) AS pico_usuarios FROM h GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: usr_lista
queryLines: WITH p AS (SELECT usuario_id, count(DISTINCT dia) AS dias_acesso_periodo, sum(eventos) AS registros_periodo, min(primeiro_registro) AS primeiro_acesso_periodo, concat_ws(', ', array_sort(collect_set(modulo))) AS modulos_usados_periodo FROM quebec.gold.vw_usr_acessos WHERE dia BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY 1) SELECT u.usuario_id, u.login, u.nome, u.email, u.departamento, u.cargo, u.situacao, u.ultimo_acesso, u.dias_sem_acesso, u.faixa_ultimo_acesso, CASE WHEN u.sem_acesso_30d THEN 'Sim' ELSE 'Não' END AS sem_acesso_30d, u.modulos_liberados, u.qtd_modulos_liberados, nullif(p.modulos_usados_periodo, '') AS modulos_usados_periodo, coalesce(p.dias_acesso_periodo, 0) AS dias_acesso_periodo, coalesce(p.registros_periodo, 0) AS registros_periodo, p.primeiro_acesso_periodo, 1 AS usuarios FROM quebec.gold.vw_usr_usuarios u LEFT JOIN p ON p.usuario_id = u.usuario_id ORDER BY u.bloqueado, u.ultimo_acesso NULLS FIRST

datasets.name: usr_modulo
queryLines: WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT usuario_id, modulo FROM quebec.gold.vw_usr_acessos WHERE dia BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim AND modulo IS NOT NULL) SELECT m.modulo, u.nome, u.login, u.ultimo_acesso, u.dias_sem_acesso, u.faixa_ultimo_acesso, 1 AS usuarios, CASE WHEN u.sem_acesso_30d THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS usuarios_sem_acesso_30d, CASE WHEN p.usuario_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS usou_no_periodo FROM quebec.gold.vw_usr_modulos m JOIN quebec.gold.vw_usr_usuarios u ON u.usuario_id = m.usuario_id AND NOT u.bloqueado LEFT JOIN p ON p.usuario_id = m.usuario_id AND p.modulo = m.modulo WHERE m.liberado

datasets.name: usr_hist
queryLines: SELECT mes, nome, login, count(DISTINCT dia) AS dias_com_acesso, count(DISTINCT dia, hora) AS horas_com_acesso, sum(eventos) AS registros, min(primeiro_registro) AS primeiro_acesso, max(ultimo_registro) AS ultimo_acesso, concat_ws(', ', array_sort(collect_set(modulo))) AS modulos_usados FROM quebec.gold.vw_usr_acessos WHERE dia BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY mes, nome, login ORDER BY mes DESC, dias_com_acesso DESC

lines: **Último acesso** = último registro do usuário na auditoria (TOTVS_AUDIT), em todo o histórico. **Sem acesso há 30+ dias** = ativos (não bloqueados) que não acessam há mais de 30 dias ou nunca acessaram: candidatos a bloquear e liberar a licença.
**Pico na mesma hora** = máximo de usuários distintos com registro na mesma hora; é a melhor aproximação do uso simultâneo que a auditoria permite (o número exato de conexões fica no License Server).
**Período:** vale só para o histórico (dias, meses, perfil por hora e módulos usados). Clique numa faixa ou num módulo para filtrar a tabela ao lado.
